description: Ingest a single source record into Anchord. The record is matched to an AnchorID automatically. Requires a registered source (system). Wraps POST /ingest/batch with a single-item array.

object_id.description: Unique ID of the record in the source system

object_type.description: Object type within the source (e.g. company, contact, customer)

payload.description: Record payload — key/value fields (e.g. name, domain, email)

system.description: Source system key (e.g. hubspot, salesforce, stripe, or a custom source)

name: ingest_record
